title: Every maintenance state change writes an audit entry
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). Open the audit trail wherever the build surfaces it for the asset/customer and check entries against the action you just performed.
  2. An enrolled asset you can drive through each state change. Seed: enrol an asset; be ready to record a reading, correct it, complete a service and undo it, skip, change a compliance record, correct a cycle date after invoicing, remove from a schedule, edit/archive/restore a schedule, and send; plus a completion done at another shop.
custom_steps:
1. Perform each state change in turn (reading, correction, completion + undo, skip, compliance record change, cycle-date correction after invoicing, enrolment, removal, schedule edit, archive, restore, send).
  2. After each, open the audit trail and confirm an entry with an actor and a timestamp.
  3. For a completion done at another shop, read where the entry records it happened.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every state change produces an entry with an actor and a timestamp - readings, corrections, completions and their undo, skips, compliance record changes, cycle-date corrections after invoicing, enrolments, removals, schedule edits, archive and restore, and sends.
  • A completion records where it happened, including when that is another shop.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S21; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S21-R1: “Every state change produces an entry with an actor and a timestamp: readings, corrections, completions and their undo, skips, compliance record changes, cycle-date corrections in the step after invoicing, enrolments, removals from a schedule, schedule edits, archive and restore, and sends”
  • S21-R3: “A completion will record where it happened, including when that is another shop”
